name: io.github.tonyyang0504/ses-mcp
description: Amazon SES (messaging): me, send. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: AWS access key id of an IAM principal allowed ses:SendEmail and ses:GetAccount.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The matching AWS secret access key; used only to derive the SigV4 signing key.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Session token when the keys are temporary STS credentials (sent as X-Amz-Security-Token).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_REGION
environmentVariables.description: AWS Region of your SES account, e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1 (the endpoint is email.<region>.amazonaws.com).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_SES_FROM_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Verified sender identity (address or an address on a verified domain) used as FromEmailAddress.
